tasks.short: Identify impacts of products, systems and projects

steps.what: Define actual product/system/project boundaries, functional unit and impact-assessment purpose
inputs: actual product/system/project description
actual assessment question and decision context

steps.what: Collect and check actual activity, material, energy and emissions evidence for the scoped product/system/project
inputs: ecologist-defined scope and impact-assessment assumptions
actual process inventory and environmental source records
outputs: checked actual environmental inventory with provenance and gaps

steps.what: Apply selected lifecycle/impact methods and inspect identified environmental impacts of the actual product, system or project
inputs: checked actual environmental inventory with provenance and gaps
ecologist-selected impact method and allocation assumptions
outputs: actual impact analysis results and sensitivity findings

steps.what: Interpret and complete the checked environmental impact findings with boundaries, uncertainty and evidence limits
inputs: actual impact analysis results and sensitivity findings
ecologist-defined scope and impact-assessment assumptions

steps.what: Save the completed checked product/system/project impact assessment
inputs: complete checked product/system/project impact assessment

tasks.design: Configure native inventory-source links and repeatable assessment profiles in {OTHER}, the lifecycle/impact-analysis application, using actual {ERP} and {SPREADSHEET} records. The ecologist defines boundaries, checks inputs and method outputs, then writes/checks findings before saving in {DOCS}; existing calculation execution earns no new saving.
tasks.previous_blocker: Repeated inventory navigation and human profile setup can consume assessment effort.
tasks.enabler_now: Native source links and profiles can reuse actual inventory references and selected methods.
tasks.still_hard: Allocation, missing inventory and system boundaries can dominate an apparent impact result.
tasks.human_edge: Recognise an impact excluded by a convenient assessment boundary.

ambition.what: No automatic environmental declaration or impact magnitude claim.

build_days.consent_and_access: 2-6 for actual inventory and licensed method access

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: native inventory links and lifecycle profiles can reduce repeated setup while scope and impact interpretation require professional judgment.

assumptions: Shares are provisional human assessment effort, not measured organisational baselines or prompt priors.

Production/accounting owners supply actual activity/material/energy records; environmental teams supply emissions evidence. The ecologist collects and checks gaps/definitions in s2; no free complete lifecycle inventory is assumed.
Only source navigation and repeated profile setup change. Manual missing-data work and method choice remain counted; equivalent current tools remove the gain.
Gross provisional saving 6 minus 1.5 hours of source/profile upkeep gives 4.5 net. The negligible save is fully retained.
This task's assessment is not added to overlapping process strategy, change analysis or MFA work in a role total.
unknowns: Actual inventory completeness and current profile reuse
research_questions: How much repeated setup remains after native lifecycle tools and input collection are credited?

already_counted.description: Collect/check inventory and inspect actual impact results

incremental.description: Maintain source links and validate assessment profiles

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Below provisional net 4.5%; scope, data gaps and substantive interpretation remain.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Review actual industrial production processes, resource losses and environmental-impact evidence
inputs: actual production process and operating constraints
actual impact, energy, material and waste evidence
outputs: ecologist-checked process impact opportunities and gaps

steps.what: Identify or develop strategies and methods to minimize actual industrial production environmental impacts
inputs: ecologist-checked process impact opportunities and gaps
actual production and environmental objectives

steps.what: Assess feasibility and displaced burdens of candidate strategies against actual industrial operating conditions
inputs: ecologist's candidate industrial reduction strategies
actual process performance and resource constraints
outputs: ecologist's assessed strategies, trade-offs and evidence limits

steps.what: Complete and check the actual environmental reduction strategy and supporting assumptions
inputs: ecologist's assessed strategies, trade-offs and evidence limits
outputs: complete checked industrial environmental reduction strategy

steps.what: Save the completed checked industrial environmental reduction strategy
inputs: complete checked industrial environmental reduction strategy

tasks.design: Configure native process/impact evidence views in {OTHER}, the industrial environmental assessment application. The ecologist develops and evaluates actual strategies using existing {SPREADSHEET} analysis, then completes/checks the strategy in {DOCS} before saving; production interventions remain under existing operational authority.
tasks.previous_blocker: Repeated evidence navigation can interrupt industrial strategy development.
tasks.enabler_now: Native source views can expose actual process losses and impacts together.
tasks.still_hard: A promising reduction can shift burdens or fail under actual industrial constraints.
tasks.human_edge: Choose a feasible strategy rather than optimise a convenient isolated metric.

ambition.what: No automatic process changes or quantified environmental improvement.

build_days.consent_and_access: 2-6 for process records and responsible operator consultation

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: native process-impact views can reduce evidence navigation while industrial environmental strategy and feasibility remain expert work.

assumptions: Shares describe unmeasured actual strategy work, not a measured production baseline.

Operators and environmental specialists supply actual process/impact records. The ecologist investigates gaps in s1 and evaluates feasibility in s3; no new sensor feed or structured opportunity list is assumed.
Only navigation changes. Existing calculations and equivalent source views remove the corresponding gain; substantive strategy writing remains retained.
Gross provisional saving 3 minus 1 hour of source-view upkeep gives 2 net. Save is negligible and fully retained.
Do not add overlapping impact identification or change-analysis time again in a roll-up.
unknowns: Current evidence views and actual feasibility data
research_questions: Does actual strategy development repeat process/evidence navigation beyond current tools?

approvals.approved_version: complete checked industrial environmental reduction strategy

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Below provisional net 2%; actual strategy and feasibility judgment remain.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Analyze complex-system environmental changes and unintended consequences

steps.what: Define the actual proposed complex-system changes, baseline, affected processes and plausible unintended consequences
inputs: actual proposed changes and system description
actual baseline evidence and stakeholder/process constraints
outputs: ecologist-defined comparison boundary and consequence pathways

steps.what: Set up and analyze actual baseline/change scenarios in native environmental systems models
inputs: ecologist-defined comparison boundary and consequence pathways
actual scenario parameters, units and provenance
outputs: actual baseline/change comparison and sensitivity results

steps.what: Evaluate environmental performance changes and unintended negative consequences, completing the checked analysis with uncertainty
inputs: actual baseline/change comparison and sensitivity results
ecologist-defined comparison boundary and consequence pathways

steps.what: Save the completed checked complex-system change/consequence analysis
inputs: complete checked complex-system change/consequence analysis

tasks.design: Configure native linked baseline/scenario profiles in {OTHER}, the environmental systems modelling application, and existing {SPREADSHEET} analysis. The ecologist supplies actual scenario assumptions, inspects calculations and interprets displaced or unintended effects before completing and saving the analysis in {DOCS}.
tasks.previous_blocker: Repeated scenario setup can consume human effort in comparing related changes.
tasks.enabler_now: Native linked profiles can reuse checked baseline parameters while exposing explicit scenario differences.
tasks.still_hard: Feedbacks, rebound and effects beyond model boundaries may defeat a tidy numerical comparison.
tasks.human_edge: Challenge a claimed improvement that excludes a plausible negative consequence.

ambition.what: No automatic change approval or claim that all consequences are captured.

build_days.consent_and_access: 2-5 for system/model evidence and configuration access

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: linked scenario profiles can reduce repeated setup while system boundaries and unintended-consequence interpretation require expert judgment.

assumptions: Shares are provisional human comparison effort, not measured system performance.
System owners supply actual baseline/change parameters and definitions. The ecologist investigates gaps and selects consequence pathways in s1 and captures/checks parameters in s2.
No unproduced structured consequence list or new sensor feed is assumed. Only repeated profile setup changes; existing equivalent profiles remove the gain and runtime already belongs to today.
Gross provisional saving 5.25 minus 1.5 hours of scenario-profile upkeep gives 3.75 net. Save is negligible and fully retained.
The final analysis is checked during interpretation/writing; operational changes require separate responsible decisions.
unknowns: Actual linked-profile coverage and unmodelled consequences
research_questions: Does linked setup reduce real comparison effort after full parameter and boundary checks?

already_counted.description: Inspect scenario results and complete/check consequence interpretation

incremental.description: Maintain and validate linked scenario profiles

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Below provisional net 3.75%; consequences and comparison validity remain human judgments.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Assess sustainability through material or substance flow analysis

steps.what: Define actual MFA/SFA boundaries, material/substance categories, accounting period and sustainability question
inputs: actual industrial system and assessment purpose
actual material/substance definitions and accounting period

steps.what: Collect, map and check actual material or substance inflows, outflows and stock-change records
inputs: ecologist's material/substance flow accounting specification
actual purchases, production, stock, waste and measured concentration records
outputs: checked mapped MFA/SFA inventory with units, provenance and gaps

steps.what: Reconcile actual material/substance balances and assess sustainability implications, uncertainty and unexplained flows
inputs: checked mapped MFA/SFA inventory with units, provenance and gaps
ecologist's material/substance flow accounting specification
outputs: actual reconciled or unresolved flow analysis and sustainability findings

steps.what: Complete and check the actual MFA/SFA sustainability assessment with balance gaps and limitations
inputs: actual reconciled or unresolved flow analysis and sustainability findings

steps.what: Save the completed checked MFA/SFA sustainability assessment
inputs: complete checked MFA/SFA sustainability assessment

tasks.design: Configure native fixed-column import/mappings from existing {ERP}/{SPREADSHEET} exports into {OTHER}, the MFA/SFA accounting application. The ecologist supplies boundaries and category mappings, checks all actual flow records, reconciles balances and completes the sustainability assessment before saving in {DOCS}; no language model estimates missing quantities.
tasks.previous_blocker: Repeated transfer of actual transaction and stock records can consume flow-accounting effort.
tasks.enabler_now: Native import/mapping can reuse checked quantities and identifiers in a stable export format.
tasks.still_hard: Incomplete boundaries, concentrations and unexplained stock changes can prevent a defensible balance.
tasks.human_edge: Investigate an unexplained imbalance rather than force the model to close.

ambition.what: No automatic sustainability rating or invented flow measurement.

build_days.consent_and_access: 2-6 for actual transaction, stock and laboratory records

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: native fixed-column import can reduce repeated flow-record transfer while boundaries, mapping and sustainability interpretation require expert validation.

assumptions: Shares are provisional human MFA/SFA effort, not a measured baseline.

Purchasing/production/warehouse owners produce actual transaction and stock exports; laboratories produce actual concentrations with units. The ecologist collects missing records, selects mappings and validates them within s2.
Imports require actual material IDs, period, amount and units. Unknown IDs, missing concentrations or incompatible units stop for manual investigation; no capture is assumed free.
Only repeatable transfer of exportable records changes. Native balance computation already belongs to today; equivalent current imports remove the gain.
Gross provisional saving 10 minus 2 hours of export/mapping upkeep gives 8 net. Save is negligible and fully retained; do not add overlapping impact-model inventory work again.
unknowns: Actual export coverage and unexplained flow records
research_questions: Does native import reduce actual MFA/SFA effort after collection, mapping and full reconciliation?

already_counted.description: Collect/check mapped records and reconcile actual flow balances

incremental.description: Maintain export mappings and investigate import failures

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Below provisional net 8%; real input collection, balance investigation and interpretation remain.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

skills_to_grow: Validate inventories, boundaries and substance mappings
role.ambitious_version: Reduce repeated inventory and scenario handling while retaining accountable industrial environmental assessment and strategy.
